description: Use this when the user wants SQL style feedback. Applies the same 10 rules as `gosqlx lint`: L001 trailing whitespace, L002 mixed indentation, L003 consecutive blank lines, L004 indentation depth, L005 line length (>100), L006 column alignment, L007 keyword case (upper), L008 comma placement (trailing), L009 aliasing consistency, L010 redundant whitespace. Returns {violation_count, violations}.
name: lint_sql
